scope: Narrow static review of six KEY_UPDATE/KEY_REQUEST public NWK boundary checks and recorder callbacks against DiscoveryLifecycleNwk. Two SNMP checks read for fixture compatibility; no expanded scope.
checks_reviewed: No-ACK KEY_REQUEST bypasses reliable capacity callback and remains immediate.
Reliable KEY_UPDATE owner exists at SendControl callback; CanSendControl executes before submission; ACK, DSCP7 and62-byte fields preserved.
Blocked reliable gate retains owner; rejected submission resets Submitted and normal same-time wake retries the original control identity.
Control queue capacity rejection cannot submit the new owner or remove the existing owner.
Fresh inline KEY_UPDATE submits only its own control while unrelated pending control and application remain queued.
Synchronous successful completion removes the original owner before returning; identity relookup prevents resurrection and keeps newly generated NeighborCheck owner intact.
probe_review: Calls use public receiveControl/controlResult/stats/neighborsSnapshot and supplied SendControl/CanSendControl interfaces.
Synchronous completion runs only for accepted KEY_UPDATE and preserves callback return value.
Repeated completion assertion and follow-on NeighborCheck observation avoid incorrectly requiring an empty control queue.
Recorded owner counts are observed through public stats; no private state access, sample substitution or forced MAC state.
limitations: Static review only: MATLAB runtime and parser execution not performed by this reviewer.
Probe is a NWK callback recorder, not a live HOP/MAC/PHY transport; it does not establish Track transition, reservation, post-TX waiting or network timing parity.
Capacity tests establish retained MATLAB safety and retry behavior, not identical native overflow policy.
Synthetic synchronous completion is a reentrancy check, not a claim that an over-the-air ACK can arrive synchronously.
